question: Large-cap four_pct_down shorts bucketed by consol_days (length of prior consolidation): expect POSITIVE top-minus-bottom effect - a breakdown out of a LONG consolidation (distribution had more time to build, more supply overhead) falls harder than a breakdown out of a short/no consolidation (fresh, less overhead supply).
plain: Does a breakdown fall further when it comes after a long sideways consolidation (more trapped buyers overhead) versus a short one?
